name: SuSIE
summary: SuSIE fine-tunes an instruction-guided image-editing diffusion model to produce a plausible near-future observation given the current image and a language command, then runs a low-level goal-reaching policy toward that image. Generating one subgoal image is far cheaper than a full video, and the image editor inherits broad semantic knowledge from internet pretraining.
innovation: Single-image subgoal generation as a lightweight substitute for full video planning.
Repurposes internet-pretrained image editors as high-level robot planners.
matters: A practical middle ground between LLM planning and expensive generative video models.
limits: Subgoal images can be physically impossible, and errors compound over long horizons.
lineage: UniPi's generative planning compressed from video to single-frame subgoals.
